description: Ministry of Industry & Commerce - Appointed of Official Receiver under Companies Act, No. 07 of 2007
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the appointment of an Official Receiver (Mr. Mathugamage Don Heshan Suranga Mathugamage) by the Minister of Industry and Commerce under the Companies Act. This falls under judicial/law enforcement matters as it concerns the administration of corporate insolvency and the court-related function of an Official Receiver, which is a judicial or quasi-judicial appointment. While a minister is named, the content does not describe his detailed portfolio responsibilities (it only states his title), so it does not qualify as a Hybrid (Type 3) gazette. The primary focus is on a law enforcement/judicial appointment.
